scripts.build: nub run --filter @renoconcierge/codeops-contracts build && nub run -r --filter './sites/*' --filter './services/*' --if-present build
scripts.test: nub run --filter @renoconcierge/codeops-contracts build && nub run -r --filter './packages/*' --filter './sites/*' --filter './services/*' --if-present --workspace-concurrency 4 test
scripts.verify: nub run build && nub run typecheck && nub run test && nub run check:chart
